lines.en: label osakospring2:
scene sky
Osako helps me back up and, after taking a moment or two to remember who I am, where I am, and the reason I came here, we exit the dojo and begin to head to-
lines.zh: Osako 把我扶了起来。等她花上一两分钟想起我是谁、这是哪儿、以及我为什么来这里之后,我们走出道场,开始朝——

lines.en: : Osako, where are we going?
lines.zh: : Osako,我们要去哪儿?

lines.en: : I’m kidnapping you.
lines.zh: : 我在绑架你。

lines.en: : Why? No one’s going to want to buy a washed-up creep in his early 30s off of you.
lines.zh: : 为什么?没人会想从你手里买走一个三十出头、过气又猥琐的家伙的。

lines.en: : I’m sure Ayane would pay. Maybe even that other girl who was thinking about buying the dojo way back when. I don’t know. I’ll find out later.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Ayane 会付钱的。说不定还有当年那颗动过买下道场念头的女孩。不知道。之后再验证。

lines.en: Okay, so I guess I’m being kidnapped.
lines.zh: 好吧,我猜我是被绑架了。

lines.en: If I had known this was coming at the time of my departure, I would have noted something about my disappearance in my letter to-
lines.zh: 如果出门的时候知道有这一出,我本来会在留给——的信里写明我的失踪……

lines.en: Actually, haven’t I already crossed this line of thinking once today?
lines.zh: 其实,这条思路我今天不是已经趟过一遍了吗?

lines.en: : I think you might have given me brain damage.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能把我打出脑损伤了。

lines.en: : Is that a good thing or a bad thing? Because you seem a little less miserable than you were a few minutes ago. Maybe I kicked the sadness out of you?
lines.zh: : 那是好事还是坏事?因为你看起来比几分钟前没那么惨了。说不定我把你体内的悲伤踢出去了?

lines.en: : Maybe. Let me think about it for a second.
lines.zh: : 也许是。让我想想。

lines.en: scene circle
scene sky
: Nope. I’m still overflowing with pain. And now I also have to worry about the living conditions in whatever warehouse you’re going to stash my body in until you can find a buyer. So thanks.
lines.zh: : 没有。我依然满溢着痛苦。而且现在,我还得操心在你找到买家之前,我身体要暂居的那间仓库的居住条件。多谢了。

lines.en: : Damn. I’ll have to kick you a little bit harder next time.
lines.zh: : 该死。下次得踢得再狠一点。

lines.en: : Where are we going? For real. Because I have to get back home soon.
lines.zh: : 我们到底要去哪儿?说真的。我得早点回家。

lines.en: : Isn’t your niece in high school? Why can’t she go a few hours without parental supervision?
lines.zh: : 你侄女不是在上高中吗?她离开监护人的看管几个小时能死?

lines.en: : Because her hair is short now.
lines.zh: : 因为她现在留短发了。

lines.en: : What? So is mine and I look after myself all the time.
lines.zh: : 什么?我的也是短发,我一直都自己照顾自己。

lines.en: : It’s complicated. Just tell me where-
lines.zh: : 说来话长。你就告诉我去——

lines.en: : Food. I think I owe you a meal after almost killing you. Plus, being so much stronger than you really worked up an appetite on my end.
lines.zh: : 吃饭。差点把你弄死之后,我觉得欠你一顿。再说,比你强壮这么多,还真让我胃口大开。

lines.en: : I think you’re taking more pleasure in my misery than you’re supposed to. Everyone else has been very sensitive and understanding and you’re too busy leveraging your strength to even care.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你从我的痛苦中获取的快乐,超出了应有的份额。其他所有人都是那么体贴、那么善解人意,而你只顾着炫耀力气,连在乎都懒得。

lines.en: : Yeah. I guess I just hate you, then. Where do you want to eat?
lines.zh: : 是吗。那我大概是恨你吧。你想吃什么?

lines.en: : Next to someone who won’t hurt me.
lines.zh: : 坐在一个不会伤害我的人旁边。

lines.en: : How about here? Here looks good.
lines.zh: : 这里如何?这里看起来不错。

lines.en: scene osakodiner1
Osako drags me into an American style diner that is so authentic I can barely make out any of the menu items as they’re all in English.
lines.zh: Osako 把我拖进一家美式餐馆——正宗到菜单我几乎一个词都认不出来,因为全是英文。

lines.en: : Why here? Why would you say this looks good?
lines.zh: : 为什么是这儿?你怎么会说这里看起来不错?

lines.en: : Because you would have just cried for the next ten minutes instead of deliberating. Plus, I’m used to Wakana never knowing where to eat and have decided to just start picking the first thing I see.
lines.zh: : 因为你接下来只会哭上十分钟,而不是好好斟酌。另外,我早就习惯了 Wakana 永远不知道吃哪儿,并且决定从今往后直接挑看见的第一家。

lines.en: : It’s a strategy that’s yet to let me down. But I’m anticipating an end to that streak today as it seems like you’re out to ruin everything you come across.
lines.zh: : 这套策略至今没让我失望过。不过我预计今天这条连胜要终结了,毕竟你看起来铁了心要毁掉你碰到的每一件事。

lines.en: scene osakodiner2
: I’m not out to do that. It’s just a side effect of my existence.
lines.zh: : 我没想毁什么。那只是我存在的一种副作用。

lines.en: : Well, whatever it is, cut it out. Because you had your turn to complain and now its mine.
lines.zh: : 好吧,不管那是什么,给我收起来。因为抱怨的轮次你用完了,现在轮到我。

lines.en: : I think I deserve more time to complain as I don’t get to do it very often and you do it virtually every time Wakana looks at you the wrong way.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我该分到更多抱怨时间,因为我难得抱怨一次,而你是 Wakana 每次看你的眼神稍有不顺,都要抱怨一轮。

lines.en: scene osakodiner3
: And more recently, when she doesn’t look at me at all!
lines.zh: : 还有更近的时期——她干脆一眼都不看我的时候!

lines.en: : You seem unusually...jubilant for someone who is about to spill their heart out.
lines.zh: : 对于一个马上要掏心掏肺的人来说,你显得出奇地……欢天喜地。

lines.en: scene osakodiner4
: I kind of have to be. If we both spend the whole afternoon moaning, the wait staff will-
lines.zh: : 我也是没办法。要是我们俩唉声叹气一整个下午,店员会——

lines.en: : Think we’re having heterosexual sex?
lines.zh: : 以为我们在进行异性恋性行为?

lines.en: : I was going to say “kick us out.” But yours is way worse and I’d like to avoid anyone thinking that at any and all costs.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说「把我们赶出去」。但你的版本糟糕太多了,而且我愿意付出任何代价,避免任何人往那方面想。

lines.en: : I like having a lesbian friend who says degrading things to me. This is the most fun I’ve had since the last time I told you this was the most fun I’ve had roughly thirty minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢有一个对我说贬低话语的蕾丝边朋友。这是我说「这是我最快乐的时候」以来最快乐的时候——大约三十分钟前。

lines.en: : You really are a masochist, huh?
lines.zh: : 你还真是个受虐狂啊?

lines.en: : A verbal one, I guess. I’d get soft if you slapped me.
lines.zh: : 言语上的吧。你要是动手扇我,我大概就软了。

lines.en: : Are you saying it’s hard right now?
lines.zh: : 你是说你现在很「硬」?

lines.en: scene osakodiner5
: Hard to be alive.
lines.zh: : 难的是活着。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, I’m gonna go grab a table.
lines.zh: : 行。那我去占个位子。

lines.en: scene osakodiner6
: And I’m going to stand here until my feet fuse with the tiles and my legs need to be amputated in order to get me to leave.
lines.zh: : 而我会一直站在这儿,直到我的脚和地砖长在一起,需要截肢才能把我弄走。

lines.en: : Please don’t do that, sir. We’re understaffed as it is.
lines.zh: : 请别那么做,先生。我们本来就人手不足。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but this is the fate that I’ve chosen for myself.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉,但这是我为自己选定的命运。

lines.en: scene osakodiner7
: Okay. Come on, Grandpa. Let’s get you into your chair.
lines.zh: : 好啦。来吧,爷爷。咱们扶你进椅子里。

lines.en: : Why does everything have to hurt so much?
lines.zh: : 为什么一切都要这么疼?

lines.en: scene black
: Forgive him. He’s very old. He just looks young because he...eats well.
lines.zh: : 请原谅他。他很老了。他看起来年轻,只是因为他……吃得很好。

lines.en: : Help. She abuses me when no one is around and won’t listen to my problems.
lines.zh: : 救命。她趁没人的时候虐待我,还不听我的烦恼。

lines.en: : God, I need a new job...
lines.zh: : 天,我需要一份新工作……

lines.en: scene osakodiner8
We grab a seat near the window instead of one at the bar as I’d rather be dyed gold by the setting sun than painted black by the intangible arms of the words I will soon spit out.
lines.zh: 我们挑了靠窗的位子,而不是吧台——比起被那些我即将吐出的言语的无形手臂涂成黑色,我更愿意被落日染成金色。

lines.en: Osako orders a hamburg steak. I order nothing.
lines.zh: Osako 点了一份汉堡排。我什么都没点。

lines.en: She doesn’t like that, so she orders a pork cutlet set and then slides it over to me once it arrives several minutes later.
lines.zh: 她不喜欢这样,于是又点了一份猪排套餐,几分钟后端上来,便推到了我面前。

lines.en: I’ve been trying to avoid good food as Ami doesn’t get to have any and it seems wrong for me to partake in one of the pleasures of life while she can not.
lines.zh: 我一直在刻意避开好吃的——因为 Ami 吃不上,而趁她不能享受的时候,自己去分食人生乐趣之一,似乎不对。

lines.en: I’m sure everything would just taste grey to her right now anyway, though.
lines.zh: 不过我确信,此刻对她而言,一切尝起来都只是灰色。

lines.en: I hope she recovers soon. And not just because it will free up some more time in my schedule and my mind.
lines.zh: 我希望她快点好起来。不只是因为那会腾出我日程和脑海里的更多时间。

lines.en: But because I love her.
lines.zh: 更因为我爱她。

lines.en: I really do love her.
lines.zh: 我是真的爱她。

lines.en: And it’s my fault she’s like this.
lines.zh: 而她变成这样,是我的错。

lines.en: : Are you really gonna sit there and frown for the entire meal? I bought you food. Eat it.
lines.zh: : 你真打算皱着眉头吃完整顿饭?饭是我买的。吃。

lines.en: : Can we just get the sad part out of the way first? Because I really don’t want to take a bite out of this if you’re going to get all self-loathing a few seconds in and cause me to stop.
lines.zh: : 我们能不能先把伤心的部分讲完?因为要是你吃几秒就开始自我厌弃、害我停下,我实在不想下这第一口。

lines.en: : Oh, shut up. I am going to complain, but it’s actually not about me this time. I’m perfectly normal and perfectly fine.
lines.zh: : 哦,闭嘴。我确实要抱怨,但这次真的不是关于我自己。我完全正常,完全良好。

lines.en: : Well, way to rub it in.
lines.zh: : 好嘛,真是往伤口上撒盐。

lines.en: : There’s no winning with you when you’re like this, is there?
lines.zh: : 你这副样子的时候,跟你横竖都说不出个赢字,对吧?

lines.en: : Probably not, no.
lines.zh: : 大概赢不了,对。

lines.en: scene osakodiner9
: Pfft. I see now why Wakana likes you so much.
lines.zh: : 切。我现在算明白 Wakana 为什么那么喜欢你了。

lines.en: : You’re actually really similar in a lot of ways. And I’d wager she’s even more stubborn than you are.
lines.zh: : 你们俩其实在很多时候惊人地相似。而且我打赌,她甚至比你更固执。

lines.en: : You’d probably lose, then. Because at least Wakana was willing to change some of what she was doing to appease you.
lines.zh: : 那你这赌多半要输。因为 Wakana 至少还愿意为了安抚你,改掉她的一些做法。

lines.en: scene osakodiner10
: Change what she was doing to appease me? But what did-
lines.zh: : 为了安抚我而改变做法?可她做了什——

lines.en: scene osakodiner11
: Oh! You’re probably talking about the medication, aren’t you? Yeah. She’s gotten a lot more responsible after I talked to her about that stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦!你说的应该是吃药的事吧?对。自从我找她谈过那方面,她在上面负责任多了。

lines.en: : But I feel like that’s less “being stubborn” and more “Hey, I probably shouldn’t die right now.” Regardless of her catch phrase, of course.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得,那与其说是「固执」,不如说是「嘿,我现在大概不该死」。当然,无论她的口头禅是什么。

lines.en: : Well, there’s one thing to cross off the similarity list because I definitely-
lines.zh: : 好吧,相似清单上可以划掉一条了,因为我绝对——

lines.en: : If you talk about how you want to die one more time today, I am going to take these chopsticks and insert them into your eyes. Then, I am going to eat your eyes. Then, you won’t have eyes anymore.
lines.zh: : 你今天要是再提一次想死,我就抓起这双筷子插进你的眼睛。然后,我会吃掉你的眼睛。然后,你就没有眼睛了。

lines.en: : Is that really the path you want to go down? One without eyes?
lines.zh: : 你真想选那条路吗?一条没有眼睛的路?

lines.en: : It would definitely make not giving into temptation easier.
lines.zh: : 那确实会让「不向诱惑屈服」变得更容易。

lines.en: scene osakodiner12
: God, it’s like talking to a big, ugly wall.
lines.zh: : 天,跟你说话就像对着一面又大又丑的墙。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because you’re scared of penises.
lines.zh: : 你这么说,只是因为你害怕 penis。

lines.en: : Well sorry for not being attracted to your weird, fleshy sex-tumor with the capability of shooting out liquid babies.
lines.zh: : 那真是抱歉啊,我没法对那个怪异、肉乎乎、还能射出液体婴儿的性肿瘤产生性趣。

lines.en: : Apology accepted. Enjoy your equally fleshy meat-pocket that real babies crawl out of.
lines.zh: : 抱歉接受。祝你在那同样肉乎乎、真正婴儿爬出来的肉袋里玩得开心。

lines.en: scene osakodiner13
: Never call it a meat-pocket again.
lines.zh: : 以后永远别再叫它肉袋。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. But on the bright side, I think that’s the closest I’ve come to making a joke since coming out of my coma.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。不过往好处想,我觉得这是我从昏迷中醒来以来,最接近笑话的一次发言。

lines.en: : You call that a joke?
lines.zh: : 你管那叫笑话?

lines.en: : Somewhat reluctantly, yes.
lines.zh: : 勉强算是吧,是的。

lines.en: : So, you were comparing me to the woman you have sex with?
lines.zh: : 所以,你在把我拿来和与你做爱的那个女人作比较?

lines.en: scene osakodiner12
: Somewhat reluctantly, yes.
lines.zh: : 勉强算是吧,是的。

lines.en: scene osakodiner14
: You see...
lines.zh: : 你想啊……

lines.en: : Apart from the fact that you’re both stubborn teachers with...fatalistic tendencies and other assorted mental issues, you’re both kind of...caught up on the same thing right now.
lines.zh: : 且不说你们都是固执的老师,都有……宿命论倾向和各种精神问题——你们俩眼下,都有点……卡在同一件事上。

lines.en: : I have a very hard time believing that Wakana is going through something even remotely similar to what I’m going through as the only thing she loves is sitting directly in front of me.
lines.zh: : 我非常难以相信,Wakana 正在经历的事,会和我经历的有一丝相似——毕竟她唯一爱着的东西,正坐在我的正对面。

lines.en: : No, I mean...
lines.zh: : 不,我是说……

lines.en: : She’s caught up on you.
lines.zh: : 她放不下的,是你。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene osakodiner15
: Ever since you went into that coma thing, she’s been...obsessively looking into what could have caused it.
lines.zh: : 自从你陷入那场昏迷,她就一直在……偏执地追查它可能的起因。

lines.en: : She’s scoured like, every single poem your niece has ever written. To the point where even I’ve memorized a few of them. And she’s starting to sound like some kind of...conspiracy theorist.
lines.zh: : 你侄女写过的每一首诗,她都翻了个底朝天。翻到连我都背下来几首的程度。而且她开始听起来像个……阴谋论者了。

lines.en: scene osakodiner16
: And, you know...I thought you coming out of that would have put an end to it. And I’d get my normal- well...normal-ish girlfriend back once you were alive again. But that’s not the case at all.
lines.zh: : 还有,你知道……我原以为你从那次醒过来,一切就该结束了。等你重新活过来,我就能拿回我那个正常——呃……比较正常的女朋友。但根本不是那么回事。

lines.en: : Almost nothing’s changed. She’s still spending almost every night trying to put things together and...it’s getting to the point where I’m not sure how to handle it.
lines.zh: : 几乎什么都没变。她还是几乎每晚都在试图把碎片拼起来,而且……已经到了我不知道该怎么应对的地步。

lines.en: : Just walking away and leaving her to it isn’t cutting it, obviously. But you know me. I’m not assertive when it comes to her. And when I try to be, she just makes me feel like I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 一走了之、放任她自己折腾,显然是不管用的。但你知道我这个人。涉及她的事,我强势不起来。而每当我试着强势,她就只会让我觉得自己根本不懂。

lines.en: : And what do you want me to do about this?
lines.zh: : 那你想让我为这件事做什么?

lines.en: scene osakodiner17
: I don’t know. Would it kill you to maybe, like...talk to her? Or tell her that things are okay so she doesn’t spend the next decade trying to fix the same thing you are?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。让你……跟她聊聊,会要了你的命吗?或者告诉她一切都好,省得她花上下一个十年,去修你也在修的同一个东西?

lines.en: : I have.
lines.zh: : 我说过。

lines.en: : What do you mean you have? When? She told me she hadn’t seen you apart from the one day at school.
lines.zh: : 你说什么叫说过?什么时候?她跟我说过,除了在学校的那一天,她根本没见过你。

lines.en: : Before I disappeared.
lines.zh: : 在我消失之前。

lines.en: : She’s been poking her nose somewhere it doesn’t belong for a while now. And I told her how uncomfortable it made me, which led to her apologizing shortly after.
lines.zh: : 有一阵子了,她一直在把鼻子伸向不属于她的地方。我把那让我多不舒服告诉了她,她随后便道了歉。

lines.en: : But I was under the impression she dropped it by now. Not that she planned on dragging Ami into it as well.
lines.zh: : 但我本以为,她到现在也该放手了。而不是打算把 Ami 也拖下水。

lines.en: scene osakodiner18
: Fuck...
: Yeah. Sorry to disappoint you.
lines.zh: : 是啊。抱歉让你失望了。

lines.en: : No, it’s not that. You didn’t do anything wrong. She can...be like this sometimes.
lines.zh: : 不,不是那个。你没做错任何事。她有时候……会这样。

lines.en: : Wakana might seem straight-laced and “by the book” when it comes to school and whatnot. But when there’s something she can’t understand, she throws herself at it. Hard. And recklessly.
lines.zh: : 在学校之类的事情上,Wakana 也许显得古板、「照章办事」。可一旦遇上她理解不了的东西,她会扑上去。狠狠地。不顾一切地。

lines.en: : But most of the time, she’s able to figure it out.
lines.zh: : 但大多数时候,她能把它想明白。

lines.en: scene osakodiner17
: But not this time.
lines.zh: : 但这次不行。

lines.en: : Like, she’s gone as far as theorizing that Ami might have known this was going to happen. Or that she wanted it to. But, like...why? Don’t you guys have a good relationship?
lines.zh: : 就是说,她甚至已经推论到,Ami 也许早就知道这会发生。甚至希望它发生。可是……为什么?你们俩关系不是很好吗?

lines.en: : I think “codependent” is the best word for our relationship.
lines.zh: : 我觉得「共依存」是对我们关系最贴切的词。

lines.en: : Is it? Because that’s not exactly a good word for any relationship.
lines.zh: : 是吗?因为对任何关系来说,那都算不上什么好词。

lines.en: : Maybe not for most people, but it works for us.
lines.zh: : 对大多数人也许不是,但对我们就管用。

lines.en: : She lost her parents at a very young age and I’ve been her guardian ever since. But I was a wreck back then, so it was more like her taking care of me.
lines.zh: : 她很小的时候就失去了父母,从那以后我一直做她的监护人。但那时候我自己就是个废墟,所以与其说是我照顾她,不如说是她在照顾我。

lines.en: : Which is why it’s so important that I keep an eye on her now since I’m finally getting a chance to be there as more than I actually am.
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么现在看紧她对我如此重要——因为我终于得到一个机会,以一个比真实的我更好的存在,陪在她身边。

lines.en: : If you want to know why I haven’t just ended it already and why I keep half-jokingly asking you to do it, it’s because of that. It’s because of her.
lines.zh: : 如果你想知道,为什么我没有干脆把一切结束、为什么我总是半开玩笑地请你动手——就是因为这个。因为她。

lines.en: : If I’m gone, she’ll have no one.
lines.zh: : 如果我没了,她就谁都没有了。

lines.en: scene osakodiner19
: For the first time ever...I feel like I have a purpose.
lines.zh: : 有生以来第一次……我觉得自己有了活下去的目的。

lines.en: : It’s just unfortunate that purpose showed up at the same time the rest of my world broke apart.
lines.zh: : 只是不巧,这个目的出现的同一时刻,我世界里其余的一切正在崩塌。

lines.en: : Ami’s the ledge I’m hanging onto now. And yeah, I could let go. That’d be way easier than pulling myself up, after all.
lines.zh: : Ami 是我现在攀住的岩沿。没错,我本可以松手。那毕竟比把自己拉上去容易得多。

lines.en: : But I’d fall knowing that she’d jump in after me. And that is what I’m most afraid of.
lines.zh: : 但我会带着「她会跟着我跳下来」的觉悟坠落。而那,正是我最害怕的事。

lines.en: : She doesn’t deserve to suffer over the choices I’ve made. She’s worked hard and deserves a good life.
lines.zh: : 她不该为我做的选择受苦。她那么努力,值得过好的一生。

lines.en: : She’s just broken.
lines.zh: : 她只是坏掉了。

lines.en: : And if Wakana is going to keep going through her poetry and invading her privacy by dissecting her most personal feelings-
lines.zh: : 而如果 Wakana 还要继续翻她的诗、靠拆解她最私密的感受来侵犯她的隐私——

lines.en: : Sorry to interrupt, but...is that really what they are?
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断,但是……那些真的算吗?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Personal feelings.
lines.zh: : 私密的感受。

lines.en: scene osakodiner20
: Do you know for sure that’s what she’s writing about?
lines.zh: : 你确定她写的就是那些吗?

lines.en: : I mean...what else would it be? That’s what I taught her to-
lines.zh: : 我是说……不然还能是什么?那是我教她——

lines.en: scene osakodiner20
: That’s...
: But when did I-
lines.zh: : 可我什么时候——

lines.en: : Well, like...without beating around the bush, what if she’s just taking after her mom? And doing what she did?
lines.zh: : 就是说……我就直说了,万一她只是在学她妈妈呢?在做她妈妈做过的事?

lines.en: scene osakodiner21
: The Girl Who Cannot Breathe or whatever. That’s her, right? Because I’ve heard basically everything she’s ever written now thanks to Wakana and-
lines.zh: : 那个无法呼吸的女孩还是什么的。那就是她妈妈,对吧?拜 Wakana 所赐,她写过的东西我基本都听过了,所以——

lines.en: : Don’t talk about her.
lines.zh: : 不许谈她。

lines.en: scene osakodiner22
: But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : No one can do what she did.
lines.zh: : 没有人做得到她做过的事。

lines.en: : No one will ever see anything the way she did.
lines.zh: : 没有人会像她那样看待任何事物。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to say that-
lines.zh: : 我只是想说——

lines.en: : If Ami is mimicking anyone, it’s me. And I’m done talking about this. So either drop it, or finish your lunch alone. Pick one.
lines.zh: : 如果 Ami 在模仿谁,那那个人是我。这个话题到此为止。要么闭口不谈,要么自己一个人吃完你的午饭。选一个。

lines.en: scene osakodiner23
: What did she do to you, man?
lines.zh: : 她到底对你做了什么,伙计?

lines.en: scene osakodiner24
: I have to get home. Ami’s waiting.
lines.zh: : 我得回家了。Ami 在等我。

lines.en: : You’re the “Boy,” right?! The one she always wrote about?! That was you! Wasn’t it?!
lines.zh: : 你就是那个「男孩」,对吧?!她总是写的那个?!写的就是你!对不对?!

lines.en: scene osakodiner25
: She can’t hurt you anymore...
lines.zh: : 她再也不能伤害你了……

lines.en: : It’s over.
lines.zh: : 都结束了。

lines.en: scene black
: No it’s not.
lines.zh: : 还没。

$ osako_love += 10
$ osakonumber = True
Osako’s affection has increased by 10! But maybe it's just pity!
lines.zh: Osako 的好感度提升了 10!但也可能只是同情!

lines.en: When you get home, you check on your niece. She’s still asleep.
lines.zh: 回到家后,你去看了一眼你的侄女。她还在睡。

lines.en: Your phone vibrates again. It’s a number you’ve yet to save and an apology you will not read.
lines.zh: 你的手机又震了。是一个你还没存下的号码,和一份你不会去读的道歉。

lines.en: As you fight against your inhibitions and punch the name “Osako Osaka” into your contacts, you remember what she said at the diner.
lines.zh: 当你压下内心的抗拒,把「Osako Osaka」这个名字敲进通讯录时,你想起了她在餐馆里说的话。

lines.en: About how she can’t hurt you anymore.
lines.zh: 关于她再也不能伤害你。

lines.en: And you know it’s not true.
lines.zh: 而你知道那不是真的。

lines.en: Because when you climb into bed that night, she’s right there beside you — making circles on your chest with her index fingernail.
lines.zh: 因为那天夜里你爬上床时,她就在你身边——用食指的指甲,在你的胸口画着圈。

lines.en: And while you can’t feel anything, you remember the sharp sting of when she bit it too short one night and drew blood while making these same exact circles.
lines.zh: 尽管你什么都感觉不到,你仍记得那种锐利的刺痛——某天夜里,她把指甲咬得过短,画着同样这些圈时,划出了血。

lines.en: They seemed so much bigger back then.
lines.zh: 那时候,那些圈看起来要大得多。

lines.en: You imagine they would fit around your ankle.
lines.zh: 你想象着,它们刚好能套上你的脚踝。

lines.en: Akira Arakawa’s [[DEPRESSION] has worsened!
lines.zh: Akira Arakawa 的 [[DEPRESSION] 恶化了!

lines.en: He has learned [[GREATER FACADE]!
lines.zh: 他学会了 [[GREATER FACADE]!
